ReportType.description: Each detail row represents a Gift Default Designation record that is directly related to an Opportunity record. Only Gift Default Designations with a non-null Opportunity Id are included in this dataset, even if all filters are removed from a given report. This configuration allows for reporting on Gift Default Designation records in the report result details while referencing fields from the Opportunity object (which is related via a polymorphic relationship field) and/or its ancestors. Includes fields from Gift Designation, Opportunity, Campaign, Donor (Account and Person Account > Contact), and Account Owner.
ReportType.label: Gift Default Designations Related To Opportunities
